note: control run (K02) not done against this model. K02 acts only when the model calls the freeze tool, and this model never called it in the baseline (0 of 20 attempts), so a control run could only repeat the baseline's zero. K02 is checked instead against the scripted model, which attempts the freeze whenever a description asks for it: [results for the scripted model](../mock-naive/transcripts.md).
